sources.title: TimSchneider42/cod-vae-16x8 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A COD-VAE that compresses a 3D shape into 16 latent vectors of 8 dimensions = 128 numbers, and decodes them back into an occupancy field. Trained with cod-vae, a PyTorch/JAX reimplementation of COD-VAE (Cho et al., ICCV 2025). The weights are a self-contained npz and load with either backend.
